answers.confusing: The objectives were unclear. There were no physical markers in the game to help figure out where to go.
answers.controlsWhy: In the tutorial, there was little indication for where to go for the grappling task. I only found out after running around the map.
answers.glitches: I noticed that when jumping on a rock, you end up inside it instead of ontop of it. I also noticed that you can walk through the wall that you summon in the rune ring (not sure if we're supposed to be able to but I assumed that it shouldn't happen).
answers.goal: Explore the world and try to complete the quests.
answers.chaos: I first noticed it when sprinting. The chaos gauge at the bottom right increased the more I would sprint. I also noticed that I could press G to automatically activate that.
answers.best: The dog transformation. I found it cool
answers.change: I would add a small 2D minimap in a corner of the screen to help the player navigate the world.
